name: eve-copilot
description: A local, character-aware AI copilot for EVE Online—from first setup to live operations.

interface.shortDescription: Your character-aware AI copilot for EVE Online
interface.longDescription: An intelligent local companion for EVE Online that turns your authorized character data, current skills, ships, assets, and location into practical decisions. Plan exploration expeditions, combat objectives, fittings, and mining campaigns; then switch to focused live guidance when you are in space. The bundled MCP runtime provides trusted EVE data and deterministic fitting checks while keeping character access on your computer.
capabilities: Guided installation and EVE application setup
Guided complete removal of plugin and private local data
Selectable neutral or faction-aligned copilot persona
Combat ship selection and fitting validation
Trusted EVE data through an agent-managed local MCP runtime
defaultPrompt: Set up EVE Copilot on this computer.
What should I do next with my current character?
Choose and fit a ship for my objective.
